rows.text: • Full year 2026 Non-GAAP diluted EPS guidance: Biogen raises the lower end of the reported range to $12.20 to $13.00 from $12.00 to $13.00 reflecting ongoing business strength and Apellis dilution favorability

With the integration progressing well, Biogen expects approximately $0.85 dilution to Non-GAAP diluted EPS for full year 2026, driven largely by lower interest income and higher interest expense associated with the transaction financing, and remains on track for the transaction to be accretive to Non-GAAP diluted EPS in 2027.
